annotations.title: Get Dilution Instrument Rows by Family

description: One instrument family's rows with per-field SEC citations (accession number, filing date and the verbatim sentence each figure was read from). Families: warrants, convertibles, preferred, shelfs, atms, elocs, s1_offerings, equity_plans, exchangeables, recent_offerings, rights; each call returns one family. `withheldRows` / `withheldRowCount`: rows that could not be verified were blanked, so every family total is a lower bound. An empty rows array on a covered company is a measured "none found in the filings read"; an unavailable response is not. `disputed` status (warrants / convertibles / preferred / exchangeables): the issuer's latest filing disputes the instrument; it is shown and excluded from totals (`summary.disputedInstrumentCount` / `disputedInstrumentShares`), and it is a disputed claim, neither outstanding nor retired. `contingencyTrigger: "event_of_default"`: the instrument is still outstanding and counted; it converts only on an event of default, which does not make it non-dilutive. Convertibles with `principalBasis` `aggregate_only` / `fair_value_only` / `conflict` / `undisclosed_since_issue`: the current balance is not measured (`principalOutstanding` null), and `principalOriginal` is the original principal, not the current balance. `conversionBasis: "formula_unanchored"`: no share count is computable, so the share count is unquantified, not zero. Convertibles / preferred `sharesIssuableBasis: "conflict_upper_bound"`: `sharesIssuableIfConverted` is an upper bound (up to that many shares) and `sharesIssuableIssuerStated` is the issuer's own count; the higher figure is not the issuer's count. Warrants with null `sharesUnderlying` beside `aggregateExerciseValueDollars` / `exercisePriceFloor` / `sharesCeilingAsFiled` are dollar-denominated or capped: `summary.warrantSharesCeiling` is a ceiling, not a count, and is not in `potentialNewShares`. `warrantCount` counts warrants, not shares. Shelfs: `babyShelfCurrentCapacityDollars` is a stored, dated figure, not today's headroom: it is as of `babyShelfCapacityAsOf` (null = undated, not current), `babyShelfCapacityBasis` names its float, and it is not the live raisable-now computation. Rights (SPAC unit rights): `rightsCount` counts rights, not shares; `sharesPerRight` is the printed fraction of a share per right; `sharesUnderlying` is the share count (null = unsized, not 0), delivered on the initial business combination and lapsing if none closes. A snapshot stored before this family existed returns `examined: false` for rights, meaning not analysed, not "no rights". Sources and dates: rows of recent_offerings, warrants, convertibles, preferred, atms, elocs, shelfs and s1_offerings carry `primarySource` {accession, formType, filingDate, url, sourceKind}, chosen from the row's own citations: offering prospectuses (424B4, 424B1, 424B5, 424B2, 424B7) first, then 8-K / 6-K, then other 424Bs, then registration statements, then periodic reports, earliest filing within a rank (shelfs and s1_offerings rank the registration statement first). `sourceKind: "later_report"` means only a 10-Q / 10-K / 20-F / 40-F cites the row, so its filingDate is when the row was reported, not when the deal was announced. `citations` is unchanged and its first entry is not the primary source. recent_offerings rows also carry `eventDate` (the closing date, else the pricing date, never a filing date) and `eventDateKind` ("closing", "pricing", or null when neither is stated). ATMs: `terminationBasis` is `terminated` (ended on `terminationDate`), `scheduled_end` (the agreement's own end date, `terminationDate`), `no_fixed_end` (runs until sold out or terminated), `not_stated` (the filings read state no end date) or `not_recorded` (extracted before this field existed, not "no end"); `terminationDate` is null unless a date was stated. A salesHistory point with `cumulativeSharesSoldStatus: "not_stated"` carries `cumulativeSharesSold: 0` as a placeholder, not a measured zero. Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data; the `available` and `reason` fields say why. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Instrument and summary share counts and per-share prices are rebased onto the current split basis (each instrument row's `basis` gives the factor applied). A row that cannot be rebased is still returned, with its share and price figures null and `basis.withheld: true` plus a reason, and summary totals omit it and count it rather than mix split bases. ATM and equity-line share figures (sold-to-date, sales history) are as reported at the time of each sale, not rebased. Historical series (get_dilution_history, and `osGrowthFacts` with `basis: "as_filed"`) are as filed, not rebased. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).

family.description: Instrument family to return. One of: warrants, convertibles, preferred, shelfs, atms, elocs, s1_offerings, equity_plans, exchangeables, recent_offerings, rights.

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.
